Надид C21H27N7O14P2 = 663.4. CAS — 53-84-9. Profile Nadide is a naturally occurring coenzyme claimed to be of value in the treatment of alcohol and opioid addiction. The reduced form of nadide, NADH, has been used in the management of chronic fatigue syndrome. Parkinsonism. The reduced form of nadide, NADH (β- NADH; reduced DPN) and its phosphate derivative (NADPH) have been given in the management of Parkinson’s disease in an attempt to enhance endogenous dopamine synthesis by stimulat- ing the enzyme tyrosine hydroxylase. Although some beneficial effects have been reported in several case series, a placebo-con- trolled study failed to find any evidence of efficacy and the rou- tine use of NADH has not been recommended.1 1.
